name: @temporal-tides/nexus-intro-scratch
description: Optional inkjs preview for Nexus intro Ink scratch (not part of root docs build)

scripts.compile: node node_modules/inkjs/bin/inkjs-compiler.js -o story.json nexus-intro.ink && node -e "const fs=require('fs');let t=fs.readFileSync('story.json','utf8');if(t.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff)t=t.slice(1);fs.writeFileSync('story.json',t);"
